episodes.name: Good Night
episodes.overview: Good Night was the first ever Simpsons short to air on The Tracey Ullman Show. The five main family members - Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie - were first introduced in this short. Homer and Marge attempt to calm their children to sleep, with the opposite results. Maggie can be heard saying "good night". She rarely talks throughout the run of the series.

episodes.name: Watching TV
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa quarrel during commercial breaks over what channel they'll watch. Repeatedly Maggie comes up to the television and changes the channel. Later Homer is saying some speech about family matters then stops when the show comes back on. A piece of music from the Tracey Ullman show plays at one part or another during the short.

episodes.name: Jumping Bart
episodes.overview: Homer makes several attempts to have Bart jump into his arms. Each time Bart jumps Homer is distracted and fails to catch him. Towards the end of the episode boxing gloves are delivered, presumably the ones used in the episode Punching Bag.

episodes.name: Babysitting Maggie
episodes.overview: Marge puts Bart and Lisa in charge of babysitting Maggie. They watch TV while Maggie gets electrocuted, falls down the stairs, and falls off the roof.  Maggie sticks a fork in an electrical socket thereby electocuting herself, she crawls up the stairs and falls down them in insane Slinky fashion then she climbs onto the roof in hot pursuit of a butterfly, and falls off it.

episodes.name: The Pacifier
episodes.overview: Lisa and Bart try to get Maggie to stop sucking on her pacifier, but Maggie, who has an entire drawer full of them, refuses to kick the habit.

episodes.name: Burping Contest
episodes.overview: Despite Marge's objections, Bart, Lisa and even Maggie compete in a contest to see who can make the most disgusting burp.

episodes.name: Dinner Time
episodes.overview: Marge serves the family purple goop for dinner, insisting that they say grace first.

episodes.name: Making Faces
episodes.overview: Despite Marge's warnings, the kids make faces. Maggie unclearly speaks in this episode.

episodes.name: The Funeral
episodes.overview: Bart is determined to see his uncle's corpse...but not for long. This is the only appearance of Uncle Hubert.

episodes.name: Maggie's Brain
episodes.overview: Bart and Lisa wonder what's inside Maggie's mind.

episodes.name: Football
episodes.overview: Homer teaches Bart about the importance of Football.

episodes.name: House of Cards
episodes.overview: Bart tries to make a house of cards, but Lisa Maggie make noises that have the "house" fall every time.

episodes.name: Bart and Homer's Dinner
episodes.overview: Bart can't stomach it when he and Homer are forced to fend for themselves.

episodes.name: Space Patrol
episodes.overview:
Bart, Lisa and Maggie play a game of "Space Patrol" while Homer and Marge are out.  Lisa plays a superhero with Maggie as her sidekick, while Bart puts a jug on his head with the pretense of it being the helmet of an alien warlord.

However, his head accidentally plops into it and the jug is left stuck on his head. Lisa "frees" Bart from the jug using a croquet mallet. Lisa and Maggie then hide, allowing Bart, stumbling in a daze amongst pieces of the precious broken jug lying on the floor, to take the blame.

episodes.name: Bart's Haircut
episodes.overview: Bart has his hair cut too short by a barber.  This is the first time we hear a character from The Simpsons series say a curse word.

episodes.name: World War III
episodes.overview: Homer wakes up the family to practice for a nuclear drill... in the middle of the night.

episodes.name: The Perfect Crime
episodes.overview: Marge bakes a batch of delicious cookies. Bart attempts to steal them, but burns his fingers trying to pick them up. Everyone except Bart and Maggie leave the kitchen to let them cool down, and Bart takes this opportunity to swipe them, muttering to himself "Aha! The perfect crime!"  Homer and Marge come back to find the tray empty. Marge suspects Maggie of eating the cookies, but as a witness she knows exactly who took them and guides them along a trail of cookies running across the floor. His family catch him lying on his back in his bedroom amidst a pile of cookie crumbs. Looking up at them with his stomach full, he groans, "There is no perfect crime." His head bangs back down on the ground and Maggie, secretively, snacks on an uneaten cookie.

episodes.name: Scary Stories
episodes.overview: Bart tells Lisa & Maggie a series of scary stories (in the middle of the dark) only to believe they're coming true.

episodes.name: Grampa and the Kids
episodes.overview: Grampa spends time with the kids.  This is Grampa's first appearance.

episodes.name: Gone Fishin' (Sort of)
episodes.overview: Bart and Homer go on a fishing trip. Homer asks Bart for a bologna sandwich, but Bart forgot the bologna. He puts the bait on the sandwich instead. Later on they hit rapids and Homer is almost knocked unconscious. They later fall off of a waterfall.

episodes.name: Skateboarding
episodes.overview: Bart teaches his sisters how to skateboard...or is it the other way around.

episodes.name: The Pagans
episodes.overview: The kids discuss paganism.  This is the first time Bart calls his dad "Homer".

episodes.name: Closeted
episodes.overview: Bart locks himself in the closet, and when he busts out, he finds out that the family has gone out without him.

episodes.name: The Aquarium
episodes.overview: At an aquarium Bart swims with the sharks...literally.  This is the first time we see a naked Simpsons character.  This also marks Lisa Simpson saying the word hell in this short.

episodes.name: Family Portrait
episodes.overview: Homer has trouble taking a normal family portrait.

episodes.name: Bart's Hiccups
episodes.overview: Lisa and Maggie try to cure Bart's hiccups...the hard way.

episodes.name: The Money Jar
episodes.overview: The kids try to steal money from Marge's money jar..

episodes.name: The Art Museum
episodes.overview: The Simpsons go to the art museum.  This is the first time we hear Bart say "Whoooa, Mama!".

episodes.name: Zoo Story
episodes.overview: Homer unwisely teases a monkey at the zoo and gets a faceful of poo for his trouble.  This is the shortest Simpsons Short.

episodes.name: Shut Up, Simpsons
episodes.overview: Maggie squeaks her toy, causing a chain reaction of anger in the family.

episodes.name: Shell Game
episodes.overview: Bart tries to hide the cookies he stole from the jar from his parents.

episodes.name: The Bart Simpson Show
episodes.overview: Bart puts on his own show after Homer tells him to stop watching cartoons. First appearance of Itchy and Scratchy.  This is the first time we hear Lisa call her dad "Homer".

episodes.name: Punching Bag
episodes.overview: Bart, Lisa and eventually Marge take out their frustrations on a punching bag with Homer's picture on it.

episodes.name: Simpsons Christmas
episodes.overview: Bart's version of Christmas.

episodes.name: The Krusty the Clown Show
episodes.overview: The kids get to see Krusty's show live for the first time. First appearance of Krusty the Clown.

episodes.name: Bart the Hero
episodes.overview: Sent out to exercise, Bart foils a robbery attempt.

episodes.name: Bart's Little Fantasy
episodes.overview: Bart tells a story about large kids who throw their small parents into a small room.

episodes.name: Scary Movie
episodes.overview: Bart, Lisa and Maggie go to the movie to see "The Happy Little Elves Return" (much to Bart's dismay), but Bart convinces the girls to see "Space Mutants" instead. Guess who's the scaredy-cat!

episodes.name: Home Hypnotism
episodes.overview: Homer tries hypnosis to calm down his crazy kids.

episodes.name: Shoplifting
episodes.overview: Bart's attempt to swipe some chocolate is foiled.

episodes.name: Echo Canyon
episodes.overview: The family drives to Echo Canyon, takes turns making echoes, and Bart almost makes a boulder crunch the family car.

episodes.name: Bathtime
episodes.overview: Homer makes Bart take his "Sunday Night Bath", only to flood the bathroom.  this is the last Simpsons short in which we see a naked Simpsons character.

episodes.name: Bart's Nightmare
episodes.overview: In this sequel to "Shell Game", Bart has a nightmare after eating every single cookie from the cookie jar.

episodes.name: Bart of the Jungle
episodes.overview: The kids swing from the trees off Homer's ties.

episodes.name: Family Therapy
episodes.overview: Homer takes the family to a psychologist.  This is last Tracey Ullman Short we hear a character from The Simpsons series say a curse word.

episodes.name: Maggie in Peril (1)
episodes.overview: Bart kicks Maggie's ball out of sight and she takes off to retrieve it back.

episodes.name: Maggie in Peril (The Thrilling Conclusion) (2)
episodes.overview: Maggie floats in the air hanging on to balloons and lands safely back in her playpen.

episodes.name: TV Simpsons
episodes.overview: Homer attempts to fix the television antenna on the roof.

episodes.name: Homer and Bart Visit the NFL on FOX
episodes.overview: A short in which Homer and Bart visit the NFL studio. The short was broadcast on NFL on FOX on September 3, 1995.

episodes.name: Springfield's Most Wanted
episodes.overview: This special was aired before the premier of the 7th season opener; hosted by John Walsh (from the FOX series "Americas Most Wanted"), it offered up all sorts of theories and insights into who might have shot Montgomery Burns.

episodes.name: A Culture Show Special
episodes.overview: Despite Marge's warnings, the kids make faces. Maggie unclearly speaks in this episode.

episodes.name: The Simpsons' Christmas Message
episodes.overview: Marge comments on David and Victoria Beckham's marriage in a negative comparison with hers and Homer's, and compared the special relationship between the UK and the US to that of Mini Me and Dr. Evil in the Austin Powers films ("Helping out in all our zany schemes to take over the world"). Lisa Simpson also held a banner supporting Cornwall's secession: "UK OUT OF CORNWALL", while chanting "Rydhsys rag Kernow lemmyn" (freedom for Cornwall now).

episodes.name: The Simpsons 20th Anniversary Special in 3-D on Ice
episodes.overview: A documentary special that examined the "cultural phenomenon" of the American animated television series. The special is hosted and directed by Morgan Spurlock.

episodes.name: Access All Areas
episodes.overview: In the first of Sky One's specials celebrating 20 years of "The Simpsons", Ricky Gervais takes you behind the scenes to see how the show is made, talking to those who put each episode together, plus celebrity fans like Simon Cowell and Hugh Hefner.

episodes.name: Mischief and Mayhem
episodes.overview: In the second of Sky One's specials celebrating 20 years of "The Simpsons", Ricky Gervais takes a look at the vast array of Simpsons merchandise the colourful characters have inspired and catches up with some of the programme's biggest devotees.

episodes.name: Celebrity Friends
episodes.overview: In the third of Sky One's specials celebrating 20 years of "The Simpsons", Ricky Gervais speaks to a selection of the huge number of celebrities who have guest-starred on the show over the years.

episodes.name: Homer Votes 2012
episodes.overview: Who will Homer Simpson vote for in the 2012 Elections? Barack Obama or Mitt Romney?

episodes.name: Mr. Burns Endorses Romney
episodes.overview: An election eve appeal from Montgomery Burns. Mr. Burns puts Shamus the dog to the test of choosing between Barack Obama and Mitt Romney.

episodes.name: Fiscal Cliff
episodes.overview: Still reeling from the presidential election results, Mr. Burns takes a few minutes to explain the upcoming fiscal cliff.

episodes.name: Maggie Sucks
episodes.overview: Maggie prepares for her Oscar acceptance speech.

episodes.name: Oscar-Nominated
episodes.overview: Maggie is interviewed for the Oscar nomination of The Longest Daycare.

episodes.name: Ice Bucket Challenge
episodes.overview: If you loved the Homer Shake...

episodes.name: Willie's Views On Scottish Independence
episodes.overview: Groundskeeper Willie has a few things to say prior to the Sept 18 Scottish elections.

episodes.name: Trumptastic Voyage
episodes.overview: A close encounter with Donald Trump's hairpiece sends Homer on an extraordinary journey.

episodes.name: Marge Simpson's ALS Ice Bucket Challenge
episodes.overview: Marge challenges Kim Jong-un to the Ice Bucket Challenge.

episodes.name: Join The Simpsons at the Daytona 500
episodes.overview: Take a look at ‘The Simpsons’ heading down to Daytona International Speedway for the Daytona 500 on February 21st.

episodes.name: The Debateful Eight
episodes.overview: Marge wakes up from a political nightmare.

episodes.name: Pokémon Now?
episodes.overview: Pokémon Now? is a special short that was released on July 16, 2016. It's a remade scene from "A Tree Grows in Springfield".

episodes.name: 3 a.m.
episodes.overview: Marge and Homer Simpson wrestle with the choice in this election.

episodes.name: Homer from the Green Room at San Diego Comic-Con 2016
episodes.overview: Homer says hello from San Diego Comic-Con 2016!

episodes.name: Homer Votes 2016
episodes.overview: The citizens of Springfield head to their polling stations to vote and Homer discovers Russia's President Vladimir Putin in disguise.

episodes.name: Happy Daytona Day!
episodes.overview: This year everyone is coming to Daytona! Don't miss the Daytona 500, FEB 26 on FOX!

episodes.name: Donald Trump's First 100 Days In Office
episodes.overview: Donald Trump reviews his accomplishments from his first 100 days in office.

episodes.name: 125 Days: Donald Trump Makes One Last Try to Patch Things Up with Comey
episodes.overview: Donald Trump makes one last try to patch things up with Comey.

episodes.name: Moe Live Tweets!
episodes.overview: Moe has a presidential moment and lets the world know how he is feeling.

episodes.name: A Public Announcement About the Eclipse
episodes.overview: Homer gives us a little advice about watching the eclipse.

episodes.name: A Message from Moe About Puerto Rico
episodes.overview: Moe has a message for the mayor of Puerto Rico, Carmen Yulín Cruz, regarding her tweet in response to the appeal for Puerto Rico that aired at the end of The Serfsons.

episodes.name: Mueller Meets Trump
episodes.overview: Robert Mueller pays the President a little visit.

episodes.name: A Tale of Two Trumps
episodes.overview: Maybe it's time to take a good look in the mirror.

episodes.name: West Wing Story
episodes.overview: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and her squad face off against President Donald Trump.

episodes.name: The Past and the Furious
episodes.overview: Lisa travels back in time to 1923 and discovers that the Springfield Mini Moose, once key to the town’s ecosystem, were driven to extinction in 1925. Teaming up with young Monty Burns, Lisa works to save the moose, but her actions unintentionally shape his future as a ruthless tycoon.

episodes.name: Yellow Planet
episodes.overview: The Simpsons explore Earth in a Nat Geo-style mockumentary.
